name: charter-showcase-ts
description: The showcase API in TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers: every Fern feature charter uses, in one small API, from an oRPC contract (src/contract.ts). The Worker serves that API (/api/mock) and is also the harness that runs the generated TypeScript SDK against it inside workerd (/api/sdk-test). npm run check is every local check; the steps are the scripts below, in the order you run them: each is charter-ts <step>, which reads charter.config.ts.

scripts.check: npm run spec:check && npm run sdk:check-spec && npm test && npm run lint && npm run test:workerd
